signal: Bitsight surpassed $200M ARR and was named a 2026 Leader in the Forrester Wave for cyber risk ratings

email.body1:
Wilder, saw Bitsight crossed $200M ARR and landed Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave.

At that scale the enterprise list grows faster than any single team can cover, and accounts go cold while reps research and write. Our AI SDR handles research, personalized writing, and follow-up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Bitsight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Wilder, quick follow-up for Bitsight.

Post-milestone, expectations on enterprise pipeline tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Bitsight needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you just add reps.
email.body3:
Wilder, last bit of proof for Bitsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bitsight's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Wilder, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. After a milestone like $200M ARR, the team's plate is full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise security motion? I'll tailor it to Bitsight either way.
